label.en: ◆ Why It Works — First-Principles Derivation (Nonlinear Functions & Function Notation)

body.en:
Why Horizontal Translations Shift in the Opposite Sign of \(h\): Suppose a function \(y = f(x)\) has a key feature (such as a vertex or intercept) at input \(x_0\), producing output \(y_0 = f(x_0)\). For the transformed function \(g(x) = f(x - h) + k\) to reach that same internal evaluation \(f(x_0)\), its input argument must equal \(x_0\):

\[ x - h = x_0 \implies x = x_0 + h \]

At this new input \(x = x_0 + h\), the output becomes \(g(x_0 + h) = f(x_0) + k = y_0 + k\). Therefore, every point \((x_0, y_0)\) on the graph of \(y = f(x)\) maps directly to \((x_0 + h, y_0 + k)\) on the graph of \(y = f(x - h) + k\) — shifting right by \(h\) units when h > 0 and vertically by \(k\) units.
body.ar:
Why Horizontal Translations Shift in the Opposite Sign of \(h\): Suppose a الدالة \(y = f(x)\) has a key feature (such as a الرأس or المقطع) at input \(x_0\), producing output \(y_0 = f(x_0)\). For the transformed الدالة \(g(x) = f(x - h) + k\) to reach that same internal evaluation \(f(x_0)\), its input argument must equal \(x_0\):

\[ x - h = x_0 \implies x = x_0 + h \]

At this new input \(x = x_0 + h\), the output becomes \(g(x_0 + h) = f(x_0) + k = y_0 + k\). وبالتالي, every point \((x_0, y_0)\) on the التمثيل البياني of \(y = f(x)\) maps directly to \((x_0 + h, y_0 + k)\) on the التمثيل البياني of \(y = f(x - h) + k\) — shifting right by \(h\) units عندما h > 0 and vertically by \(k\) units.

الشرح الرياضي (الدوال غير الخطية وترميز الدوال والتحويلات):

If \( f(x) = x^2 - 1 \), find \( f(4) \).

Substitute \( x = 4 \): \[ f(4) = 4^2 - 1 = 16 - 1 = 15. \]

question.en:
Level 1 · Foundations

For the function \( f(x) = 2x^2 - 3x + 5 \), what is the value of \( f(-3) \)?
question.ar:
Level 1 · Foundations

For the function \( f(x) = 2x^2 - 3x + 5 \), ما قيمة \( f(-3) \)?

solution.en:
Substitute \( x = -3 \) into the expression, taking care with negative signs:

\[ f(-3) = 2(-3)^2 - 3(-3) + 5 = 2(9) + 9 + 5 = 18 + 9 + 5 = 32. \]
solution.ar:
عوّض \( x = -3 \) into the expression, taking care with negative signs:

\[ f(-3) = 2(-3)^2 - 3(-3) + 5 = 2(9) + 9 + 5 = 18 + 9 + 5 = 32. \]

hints.en: Substitute \( x = -3 \) into the expression, taking care with negative signs: \(f(-3) = 2(-3)^2 - 3(-3) + 5\).
hints.ar: عوّض \( x = -3 \) into the expression, taking care with negative signs: \(f(-3) = 2(-3)^2 - 3(-3) + 5\).

label.en: ⚠️ SAT Traps & Pitfalls — Function Transformations & Notation
label.ar: ⚠️ SAT Traps & Pitfalls — الدالة Transformations & Notation

body.en:
• Horizontal Shift Direction: \( f(x - c) \) shifts the graph \( c \) units to the right, whereas \( f(x + c) \) shifts it \( c \) units to the left.
  • Input vs. Output: For \( f(x) = 12 \), you are finding the input \( x \) that yields 12 (solving \( f(x) = 12 \)), NOT calculating \( f(12) \)!
  • Composition Evaluation Order: In \( f(g(x)) \), evaluate the innermost expression \( g(x) \) first, then pass the resulting value into \( f \).
  • Undefined Points / Domain Restrictions: Radical functions require non-negative radicands (\( x \ge 0 \)), and rational functions are undefined where the denominator is zero.
body.ar:
• Horizontal Shift Direction: \( f(x - c) \) shifts the التمثيل البياني \( c \) units to the right, whereas \( f(x + c) \) shifts it \( c \) units to the left.
  • Input vs. Output: For \( f(x) = 12 \), you are finding the input \( x \) that yields 12 (solving \( f(x) = 12 \)), NOT calculating \( f(12) \)!
  • Composition Evaluation Order: In \( f(g(x)) \), احسب قيمة innermost العبارة الجبرية \( g(x) \) first, then pass the resulting value into \( f \).
  • Undefined Points / المجال Restrictions: Radical الدوال require non-negative radicands (\( x \ge 0 \)), and rational الدوال are undefined حيث the denominator is zero.

body.en:
For \( f(x) = 3x - 5 \) and \( g(x) = x^2 + 2 \), evaluate \( g(f(2)) \).

Evaluate inner function: \( f(2) = 3(2) - 5 = 1 \).

Substitute into outer function: \( g(1) = 1^2 + 2 = 3 \).
body.ar:
For \( f(x) = 3x - 5 \) and \( g(x) = x^2 + 2 \), احسب قيمة \( g(f(2)) \).

Evaluate inner الدالة: \( f(2) = 3(2) - 5 = 1 \).

Substitute into outer الدالة: \( g(1) = 1^2 + 2 = 3 \).

question.en:
Level 2 · Medium

Let \( f(x) = x - 4 \) and \( g(x) = 2x^2 + 1 \). If \( h(x) = g(f(x)) \), what is the value of \( h(1) \)?
question.ar:
Level 2 · Medium

ليكن \( f(x) = x - 4 \) and \( g(x) = 2x^2 + 1 \). إذا كان \( h(x) = g(f(x)) \), ما قيمة \( h(1) \)?

solution.en:
Step 1: Evaluate inner function at 1: \[ f(1) = 1 - 4 = -3. \]

Step 2: Pass result into \( g(x) \): \[ g(-3) = 2(-3)^2 + 1 = 2(9) + 1 = 18 + 1 = 19. \]
solution.ar:
Step 1: احسب قيمة inner function at 1: \[ f(1) = 1 - 4 = -3. \]

Step 2: Pass result into \( g(x) \): \[ g(-3) = 2(-3)^2 + 1 = 2(9) + 1 = 18 + 1 = 19. \]

hints.en: Pass result into \( g(x) \): \(g(-3) = 2(-3)^2 + 1\). Substitute and simplify: \(g(-3) = 2(9) + 1\).
hints.ar: Pass result into \( g(x) \): \(g(-3) = 2(-3)^2 + 1\). عوّض بالقيم وبسّط العبارة: \(g(-3) = 2(9) + 1\).

body.ar:
الشرح الرياضي (الدوال غير الخطية وترميز الدوال والتحويلات):

Let \( f(x) = \begin{cases} x^2 & x < 2 \\ 3x - 1 & x \ge 2 \end{cases} \). Find \( f(-1) \) and \( f(4) \).

For \( x = -1 < 2 \), use \( x^2 \): \( (-1)^2 = 1 \).

question.en:
Level 3 · Advanced

For the piecewise function \( g(x) = \begin{cases} 2x + 5 & x \le -1 \\ x^2 - 3 & x > -1 \end{cases} \), what is the value of \( g(-1) + g(3) \)?
question.ar:
Level 3 · Advanced

For the piecewise function \( g(x) = \begin{cases} 2x + 5 & x \le -1 \\ x^2 - 3 & x > -1 \end{cases} \), ما قيمة \( g(-1) + g(3) \)?

solution.en:
Evaluate \( g(-1) \): Since \( -1 \le -1 \), use the first piece: \[ g(-1) = 2(-1) + 5 = 3. \]

Evaluate \( g(3) \): Since \( 3 > -1 \), use the second piece: \[ g(3) = 3^2 - 3 = 6. \]

Sum: \[ g(-1) + g(3) = 3 + 6 = 9. \]
solution.ar:
احسب قيمة \( g(-1) \): Since \( -1 \le -1 \), use the first piece: \[ g(-1) = 2(-1) + 5 = 3. \]

احسب قيمة \( g(3) \): Since \( 3 > -1 \), use the second piece: \[ g(3) = 3^2 - 3 = 6. \]

Sum: \[ g(-1) + g(3) = 3 + 6 = 9. \]

hints.en: Evaluate \( g(-1) \): Since \( -1 \le -1 \), use the first piece: \(g(-1) = 2(-1) + 5\).
hints.ar: احسب قيمة \( g(-1) \): Since \( -1 \le -1 \), use the first piece: \(g(-1) = 2(-1) + 5\).

hints.en: Evaluate \( g(3) \): Since \( 3 > -1 \), use the second piece: \(g(3) = 3^2 - 3\).
hints.ar: احسب قيمة \( g(3) \): Since \( 3 > -1 \), use the second piece: \(g(3) = 3^2 - 3\).
تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(g(-1) + g(3) = 3 + 6\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

label.en: Level 4 (Synthesis) — Interpreting \(y\)-Intercept of Shifted Rational/Exponential Functions
label.ar: Level 4 (Synthesis) — Interpreting \(y\)-المقطع of Shifted Rational/Exponential الدوال

body.en:
Problem: The function \( f(x) = 3^x + 4 \) is translated 2 units to the left and 5 units down to form \( g(x) \). What is the \( y \)-intercept of \( y = g(x) \)?

Solution: Translating 2 units left replaces \( x \) with \( x + 2 \), and 5 units down subtracts 5:

\[ g(x) = f(x + 2) - 5 = 3^{x+2} + 4 - 5 = 3^{x+2} - 1. \]

Evaluate at \( x = 0 \): \( g(0) = 3^2 - 1 = 8 \), so the \( y \)-intercept is \( (0, 8) \).
body.ar:
Problem: The الدالة \( f(x) = 3^x + 4 \) is translated 2 units to the left and 5 units down to form \( g(x) \). What is the \( y \)-المقطع of \( y = g(x) \)?

Solution: Translating 2 units left replaces \( x \) with \( x + 2 \), and 5 units down subtracts 5:

\[ g(x) = f(x + 2) - 5 = 3^{x+2} + 4 - 5 = 3^{x+2} - 1. \]

Evaluate at \( x = 0 \): \( g(0) = 3^2 - 1 = 8 \), so the \( y \)-المقطع is \( (0, 8) \).

question.en:
Level 4 · Synthesis

If \( f(x - 3) = 4x + 5 \) for all real numbers \( x \), what is the value of \( f(2) \)?
question.ar:
Level 4 · Synthesis

إذا كان \( f(x - 3) = 4x + 5 \) for all real numbers \( x \), ما قيمة \( f(2) \)?

solution.en:
To evaluate \( f(2) \), set the input expression \( x - 3 \) equal to \( 2 \):

\[ x - 3 = 2 \implies x = 5. \]

Substitute \( x = 5 \) into the right-hand side:

\[ f(2) = 4(5) + 5 = 25. \]
solution.ar:
To احسب قيمة \( f(2) \), set the input expression \( x - 3 \) equal to \( 2 \):

\[ x - 3 = 2 \implies x = 5. \]

عوّض \( x = 5 \) into the right-hand side:

\[ f(2) = 4(5) + 5 = 25. \]

hints.en: To evaluate \( f(2) \), set the input expression \( x - 3 \) equal to \( 2 \): \(x - 3 = 2 \implies x\).
hints.ar: To احسب قيمة \( f(2) \), set the input expression \( x - 3 \) equal to \( 2 \): \(x - 3 = 2 \implies x\).

hints.en: Substitute \( x = 5 \) into the right-hand side: \(f(2)\). Rewrite and substitute: \(f(2) = 4(5) + 5\).
hints.ar: عوّض \( x = 5 \) into the right-hand side: \(f(2)\). Rewrite and عوّض: \(f(2) = 4(5) + 5\).

hints.en: Evaluate \(4(5) + 5\) to obtain the final answer.
hints.ar: احسب قيمة \(4(5) + 5\) to obtain the final answer.

question.ar: إذا كان \( f(x) = 2x^2 - 3 \), what is \( f(-2) \)?

solution.en: Substitute \( x = -2 \) into the function: \( f(-2) = 2(-2)^2 - 3 = 2(4) - 3 = 8 - 3 = 5 \).

label.en: ● Master Atlas of the 9 Main Parent Functions & Universal Transformation Law
label.ar: ● الأطلس الشامل للدوال الأم التسع وقانون التحويلات الهندسية العام

body.en:
Every algebraic and elementary transcendental model is built by transforming one of the nine core parent functions via \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\), where \(|a|\) scales vertically (reflecting across the \(x\)-axis if \(a < 0\)), \(h\) shifts horizontally, and \(k\) shifts vertically:

FamilyTransformed Form \(g(x)\)DomainRange (\(a > 0\))Key Geometric Feature
Constant\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)Horizontal line, slope \(0\)
Linear\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Constant slope \(m = a\), pivot \((h, k)\)
Quadratic\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Parabola vertex \((h, k)\), axis \(x = h\)
Cubic\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Inflection center \((h, k)\), S-curve
Absolute Value\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)V-corner vertex \((h, k)\), slopes \(\pm a\)
Radical\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Endpoint \((h, k)\), half-parabola
Rational\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), horizontal \(y = k\)
Exponential\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)Horizontal asymptote \(y = k\), anchor \((h, a+k)\)
Logarithmic\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), anchor \((h+1, k)\)
body.ar:
تُبنى النماذج الجبرية والمتسامية الأساسية من خلال تطبيق التحويل القياسي \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\) على إحدى الدوال الأم التسع، حيث يتحكم \(|a|\) في التمدد الرأسي (مع انعكاس حول محور السينات إذا كان \(a < 0\))، ويمثل \(h\) الإزاحة الأفقية، و\(k\) الإزاحة الرأسية:

عائلة الدالةالصورة المحوّلة \(g(x)\)المجالالمدى (\(a > 0\))السمة الهندسية المميزة
الثابتة\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)مستقيم أفقي ميله \(0\)
الخطية\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)ميل ثابت \(m = a\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, k)\)
التربيعية\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)قطع مكافئ رأسه \((h, k)\) ومحوره \(x = h\)
التكعيبية\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)نقطة انعطاف مركزية \((h, k)\)
القيمة المطلقة\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)رأس زاوي على شكل V عند \((h, k)\) بميلين \(\pm a\)
الجذرية\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)نقطة بداية \((h, k)\) ومجال مقيّد \(x \ge h\)

note.ar: بدّل بحرية بين عائلات الدوال الأم التسع جميعاً واسحب مباشرة على المستوى الإحداثي لتحريك النقطة المحورية \((h, k)\). توضح الخطوط المتقطعة خطوط التقارب الرأسية (\(x = h\)) والأفقية (\(y = k\)) للدوال النسبية والأسية واللوغاريتمية.
